create_Ion_from_atoms: create an Ion object by passing an ase.Atoms object representing the ion structure
create_Ion_from_db_index: create an Ion object by passing an integer index to select a specific ion from the database
create_Ion_random: create an Ion object that randomly selects an ion from the pickle database file
get_ion_concentration: compute the ion concentration in molarity units given a volume in Angstrom cubed
review_Ion_class: review the Ion class that wraps ase.Atoms objects with charge and database loading support
